# OrangutanAdventureSumatra

OrangutanAdventureSumatra is an ethical orangutan trekking and jungle adventure website for Bukit Lawang, North Sumatra, Indonesia.

Canonical website: https://www.orangutanadventuresumatra.com

Language versions:
- English: https://www.orangutanadventuresumatra.com/en
- German: https://www.orangutanadventuresumatra.com/de
- French: https://www.orangutanadventuresumatra.com/fr
- Dutch: https://www.orangutanadventuresumatra.com/nl

Primary services:
- Ethical orangutan trekking in Bukit Lawang and Gunung Leuser National Park
- 4-hour, 1-day, 2-day, 3-day, 4-day, and 5-day jungle trekking packages
- Private eco jungle packages
- Eco workout treks
- Riverside camps and traditional tube rafting options
- Local Indonesian guide team
- Transport and accommodation support

Responsible trekking policy:
- No guaranteed wildlife claims
- No feeding orangutans or other wildlife
- No touching orangutans
- Keep a proper distance from wildlife
- Follow the local guide inside the rainforest

Booking contact:
- WhatsApp: +62 813-6252-5273
- Email: contact@orangutanadventuresumatra.com

Important notes:
- Treks start from Bukit Lawang, North Sumatra, Indonesia.
- Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed because orangutans and other animals move freely.
- The site publishes package information, FAQs, guide details, gallery content, and direct booking calls to action.
